note: SOUNDSCAPE TEST (only with &sound=1). Each passage is a group of rooms that share one soundscape. Inside a passage the sound keeps running; crossing into another passage fades across over 'fade' seconds. Files are read from pre_lab_hostory/SoundScape by name. 'seam' = seconds each loop repeat crosses the last. 'volume' 0 to 1 (0.4 = background, under the voice and the sound effects). To try the other Weighted Silence, change its 'file' to the 'alternative'.
